title: Open Neuromorphic Computing Hub
summary: The Open Neuromorphic website serves as a community hub for brain-inspired computing, offering guides on neuromorphic hardware specifications and software frameworks like Spiking Neural Networks. It hosts peer-reviewed research programs, workshops such as 'Hacking Hours' held in October 2025, student talks, and blog updates including leadership changes announced in February 2026. The platform facilitates collaboration through Discord events and standardized benchmarking initiatives.
tldr: Open Neuromorphic provides hardware/software guides, peer review programs, workshops, and community resources for neuromorphic computing research and development.
evidence: - Neuromorphic Hardware Guide Explore detailed specs, papers, and development status of cutting-edge neuromorphic hardware from research and industry.
- Discover open-source SNN frameworks, event-based data tools, and essential libraries for your neuromorphic projects.
- Our community-driven peer review program for open, reproducible, and high-impact research. Get your work recognized with the 'ONM Community Approved' badge.
